Responsabilidades da Oportunidade
Você é apaixonado pela advocacia e busca flexibilidade e independência em sua carreira? Então, temos uma proposta incrível para você!
No Programa de Parceria do Advogado Online, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma, definindo seus próprios horários e metas. Aqui, você será seu próprio chefe e poderá exercer sua profissão com independência e liberdade.

  3. Gerenciar seus horários e compromissos de acordo com suas preferências.
  4. Ganhar dinheiro conforme sua disponibilidade e interesse.

Como serão os seus ganhos:
Ganhe de acordo com o seu desempenho! Em nosso Programa de Parceria, você tem o poder de determinar o valor que irá receber, com base na quantidade e qualidade das tarefas que realizar.

Advogados ou bacharéis.

description:
QA Automation - Presencial Curitiba - Inglês Avançado

A Capco é uma consultoria global de tecnologia e gestão especializada na transformação digital, oferecendo soluções inovadoras e orientadas por dados para um portfólio crescente de mais de 100 clientes globais, entre eles bancos, pagamentos, mercados de capitais, gestão de patrimônio e ativos, seguros e setor de energia. Nos destacamos pela abordagem personalizada, focada na construção de parcerias estratégicas de longo prazo e na aceleração de iniciativas digitais. Nossa expertise ganha vida por meio dos Innovation Labs e da cultura premiada #BeYourselfAtWork, que valoriza a diversidade e o talento. Com presença global nos principais centros financeiros - temos 33 escritórios nas Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico - estamos comprometidos em oferecer soluções práticas e integradas, promovendo colaboração e confiança em cada projeto. Se criatividade e inovação são sua paixão, a Capco é ideal para você. Vamos te apoiar e ajudar a acelerar sua carreira!

Estamos em busca de Engenheiros(as) de Qualidade experientes, com aproximadamente 5 anos de atuação profissional em testes de software e garantia da qualidade. Os(as) candidatos(as) ideais devem possuir sólida experiência prática com ferramentas de automação de testes , especialmente Selenium e Tosca , além de um forte entendimento dos processos de teste ponta a ponta em ambientes Ágeis .

Responsabilidades Principais:

  1. Projetar, desenvolver e manter scripts de testes automatizados utilizando Selenium e Tosca.
  2. Executar testes funcionais, de regressão e de integração para validar a funcionalidade e o desempenho dos sistemas.
  3. Identificar, documentar e acompanhar defeitos, trabalhando em conjunto com os desenvolvedores para garantir sua resolução em tempo hábil.
  4. Contribuir para a melhoria contínua das práticas de testes e da cobertura de automação.

Qualificações Necessárias:

  • +5 anos de experiência em garantia da qualidade de software ou automação de testes.
  • Experiência comprovada com automação de testes utilizando Selenium e Tosca.
  • Sólido entendimento do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software (SDLC), metodologias Ágeis e boas práticas de QA.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e trabalho em equipe.
  • Graduação em TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Inglês avançado.

Ao juntar-se à Capco, você ingressa em uma organização comprometida com um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, onde é incentivado a #BeYourselfAtWork (Ser Você Mesmo no Trabalho). Celebramos a individualidade e reconhecemos que diversidade e inclusão são essenciais para o sucesso. Valorizamos o que torna cada pessoa única e gostaríamos de saber o que te diferencia!

Nosso processo seletivo é flexível e adaptado às necessidades de cada oportunidade e talento, podendo ser ajustado dependendo da senioridade, área de atuação e formato do projeto.

title: Analista de customer experience
description:
O Analista de Customer Experience (CX) será responsável por monitorar e responder às interações e feedbacks no Reclame Aqui, acompanhando a satisfação dos clientes (CSAT) e contribuindo ativamente para a melhoria contínua de nossos processos de atendimento. Além disso, esse analista apoiará o desenvolvimento e a gestão de conteúdos na Central de Ajuda, garantindo que a experiência do cliente seja eficiente e resolutiva.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  1. Monitorar e gerenciar o atendimento no Reclame Aqui, respondendo e resolvendo solicitações dos clientes de maneira ágil e empática;
  2. Analisar e acompanhar as métricas de satisfação do cliente (CSAT), sugerindo melhorias com base nos feedbacks recebidos;
  3. Colaborar com as equipes de suporte para identificar oportunidades de aprimoramento no atendimento e propor ações preventivas para recorrências de problemas;
  4. Contribuir com a criação e a manutenção de conteúdos na Central de Ajuda, garantindo que sejam claros, atualizados e úteis para os clientes;
  5. Preparar relatórios de desempenho de atendimento e feedbacks dos clientes, apresentando insights e tendências para a liderança;
  6. Apoiar na criação de estratégias de Customer Experience que promovam a satisfação e fidelização dos clientes.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  1. Experiência prévia em Customer Experience, Atendimento ao Cliente ou áreas relacionadas;
  2. Experiência na utilização e monitoramento de plataformas de feedback, como Reclame Aqui, e conhecimento de métricas de satisfação (CSAT);
  3. Habilidade analítica para interpretar dados de satisfação do cliente e propor ações de melhoria;
  4. Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com foco em clareza e empatia no atendimento;
  5. Proatividade, organização e habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa com diferentes times;
  6. Desejável conhecimento em ferramentas de CRM e plataformas de suporte ao cliente;
  7. Formação superior completa ou em andamento em áreas relacionadas, como Administração, Gestão de Qualidade, Gestão de TI, ou afins.

Fazendo parte do time, você terá SuperBenefícios como:

  1. Flexibilidade de horário;
  2. Ajuda de custo Home Office;
  3. Flash Benefícios Flexíveis (VA + VR);
  4. Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  5. Apoio aos pais;
  6. Saúde e Bem-estar;
  7. Treinamentos e educação;
  8. Ambiente que valoriza feedbacks 1:1.

title: Analista de planejamento financeiro pleno fp a
description:
Muito Prazer! Somos a Monte Bravo.

A Monte Bravo nasceu em 2010, do sonho dos nossos sócios fundadores Pier Mattei e Filipe Portella e, desde então, busca fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas através do Mercado Financeiro. Para isso, procuramos unir uma equipe de especialistas para olhar atentamente o patrimônio de cada cliente.

Em 2024, nos tornamos uma das maiores corretoras de investimento do Brasil.

A área de planejamento financeiro é responsável por desenvolver análise na formulação de estratégias financeiras para otimizar o desempenho econômico da empresa, trabalhando em colaboração com diversas áreas para fornecer informações estratégicas e insights que ajudem na tomada de decisões informadas e na condução do sucesso financeiro da organização.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Colaborar no desenvolvimento e execução de modelos financeiros que auxiliem na previsão de receitas, despesas e fluxo de caixa;
  • Analisar os resultados financeiros atuais e históricos, identificando tendências, variações e áreas de melhoria;
  • Participar na elaboração de orçamentos e planos de negócios, garantindo que estejam alinhados com as metas estratégicas da empresa;
  • Realizar análises de viabilidade financeira para novos projetos, investimentos e oportunidades de expansão;
  • Contribuir para a elaboração de relatórios financeiros e apresentações executivas que comuniquem informações chave aos stakeholders;
  • Fornecer insights para a equipe de gestão em relação às implicações financeiras das decisões estratégicas;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho financeiro real em relação ao planejado, identificando desvios e propondo ações corretivas;
  • Participar na identificação e na implementação de melhorias nos processos de planejamento financeiro;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as melhores práticas de planejamento financeiro e as tendências do mercado.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Graduação em Finanças, Contabilidade, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em modelagem financeira e domínio de ferramentas como Excel;
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de ERP e software de planejamento financeiro é um diferencial;
  • Habilidade de interpretar dados financeiros complexos e comunicar insights de maneira clara.

Informações Adicionais

  • Remuneração fixa e PLR competitiva ao mercado;
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Cartão de Benefícios Caju (Refeição e Alimentação);
  • Gympass - Academia e saúde do corpo onde você quiser!

Todas as nossas vagas são aplicáveis para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCDs). Caso você tenha interesse em fazer parte do Time Monte Bravo Corretora, inscreva-se na vaga ou no nosso banco de talentos!

About Salesforce

We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good – you’ve come to the right place.

Local: Argentina or Chile

The Marketing Cloud Sales Engineering team is an innovative group of professionals at the heart of the Marketing Cloud’s industry-leading solutions. This talented team helps Salesforce customers and prospects develop and implement strategies to take their digital marketing efforts to an entirely new level. Through collaboration with the customer, the Marketing Cloud Products team, Professional Services, and the Solutions Engineers develop unique solutions that help our customers connect with their customers in new ways. The SE world is a dynamic, ever-changing environment where expertise in design, business consulting, and technology is leveraged every day to drive innovation.

The Solution Engineering team sits at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, Professional Services, and Product. This unique perspective creates an opportunity for the SE to interact with the entire customer lifecycle. If you enjoy a fast-paced environment full of interesting challenges and opportunities to create compelling Solutions in the field of digital marketing then the Marketing Cloud SE team is the department for you.

Your Impact:

A Solution Engineer at Salesforce Marketing Cloud plays a pivotal role in aligning innovative digital marketing strategies to technology solutions within key strategic accounts. This role focuses on partnering with clients and collaborating with internal team members and C-level client contacts to drive consensus on multi-product technology solutions across the various Salesforce product lines. Solutions Engineers work on a wide array of assignments including business development, operations and IT strategies, as well as executive level product demonstrations. This person must assume the role of trusted advisor for driving innovative solutions forward while also improving business performance. The Solutions Engineer focuses primarily in these three areas:

  1. Business Problem Solving: Take ambiguous and complex business problems and using research and business assessment capabilities, define the problem, drive innovative ideas, define the opportunity set, and recommend actionable next steps.
  2. Innovation Management: Bring rigor to a client’s decision-making process by presenting and evaluating solution options, and driving consensus among key stakeholders. In some instances, we help our clients develop new decision frameworks and governance processes that continue to deliver value far beyond a particular engagement.
  3. Connect Experiences: Demonstrate through software demos and rapid prototyping how connected experiences come to life with The Salesforce Marketing Cloud. This includes the delivery of executive level software demonstrations, construction of future state customer journey strategies, and developing long-term IT roadmaps.

“Solutioning” is fundamental to the Marketing Cloud SE role. It is important to realize that a component of the responsibilities will include assisting the customer, Account Executive, and Professional Services team with the discovery, analysis, and ultimately the recommendation of strategic solutions for the customer by delivering visionary pitches based in live product demonstrations to validate. These Solutions will leverage the Marketing Cloud technology to address the core marketing challenges and objectives that are uniquely identified for each customer.

Preferred Requirements:

  1. Technical knowledge in programming language like Ampscript, integration, API call
  2. Minimum 2 years of experience in Salesforce Marketing Cloud as a user, implementer or Solution Engineer
  3. Excellent communication and presentation skills; dynamic (persuasive) in presenting ideas to clients and prospective clients from VP to C-level
  4. Demonstrated success driving organisational change within client organisations
  5. Past experience in organisational design consulting, process design and optimisation, digital governance, and team dynamics a strong plus
  6. Ability to work with a broad team across multiple disciplines to help customers transform their business using the Salesforce Customer Success Platform
  7. Analyse, structure, and negotiate long-term technology roadmap initiatives with clients and partners
  8. Ability to understand, communicate and manage across the entire project lifecycle
  9. Broad knowledge of technology trends and relevance to clients businesses
  10. Proven experience leading strategy and digital roadmap projects in a complex business and marketing environment
  11. Strong understanding of user research, user-centered design principles and online consumer behavior

Overview

Want to Join the Best in Pest ? Go Pro with Orkin.

As an Orkin Pro, you’ll be the pro fessional delivering on the promise of a safe place to live, work, and play behind pest control’s best-known brand .

Be part of a purpose-driven team with a reputation built on almost 125 years of a service-minded approach to providing peace of mind where people value it most: their home.

It’s more than a job—it’s a career with growth potential and benefits that go beyond the basics. And with Orkin’s award-winning training program, we’ll give you all the tools and technology you need to succeed . That means no industry experience required to start and build a career as an Orkin expert.

Plus, if there’s one thing we know at Orkin, it’s that pests keep coming back, and that makes our industry recession-resistant.

You can count on a career with the Best in Pests where you’ll work alongside a team that values safety, professionalism, empathy, integrity and innovation in pursuit of our mission to deliver the peace of mind only an Orkin Pro can provide.


Responsibilities

The Orkin Pro commits to safely and professionally providing the highest level of protection and service to their customers on a designated service route. Their career starts with in-depth, award-winning training that prepares them with the skills needed to succeed in the responsibility of daily route operations, scheduling, issue diagnosis and treatment planning. With each customer, Orkin Pros work to understand problems and do the right thing to resolve them.

You will...

  • Complete our award-winning training to learn the skills and knowledge required to serve our customers
  • Prioritize safety in all responsibilities
  • Follow a route schedule and daily operation schedule within an assigned territory and ensure timely and safe arrival at each customer’s location
  • Operate a company vehicle safely and ensure cleanliness of the vehicle and equipment
  • Conduct yourself with the utmost professionalism and integrity with customers and coworkers
  • Serve as a problem solver for each customer with empathy by listening to and understanding their needs and utilizing Orkin Pro expertise to recommend the most efficient and innovative solution
  • Meet with customers in their businesses or homes to explain actions taken, ensure satisfaction, and discuss additional services that would give them peace of mind about their pest management
  • Inspect the interior and exterior of the customer’s property—don’t worry, we teach you how!
  • Communicate with customers to explain actions taken, ensure satisfaction, and discuss additional services that would give them peace of mind about their pest management program
  • Complete all required service-related documentation in a handheld device provided for speed and accuracy

We Offer...

  • Competitive earnings starting at $18 to $20 per hour, including a company vehicle with gas card upon route assignment
  • Extensive paid training up front and on an ongoing basis to support continuous improvement; no prior pest control experience is required
  • Career opportunities to grow and advance in the company and improve compensation
  • Competitive pay with commission opportunity
  • Company vehicle and gas card
  • Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision & life insurance
  • 401(k) plan with company match, employee stock purchase program
  • Paid vacation, holidays and sick leave
  • Employee discounts, tuition reimbursement and dependent scholarship awards

Why Orkin?

  • You are interested in an opportunity with career potential in a reliable, recession-resistant industry
  • You have a service-oriented mindset that leads you to build loyalty and trust with customers
  • You hold yourself responsible to commitments
  • You value being part of a team
  • You want to keep learning, improving and developing as a leader
  • You want to join a company that supports the community
  • You want a career with a purpose at a mission-driven company that values
    • Safety
    • Professionalism
    • Empathy
    • Integrity
    • Innovation

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements:

  • No Experience Required – we’ll train you to be a Pro!
  • High School Diploma or equivalent required
  • Valid driver’s license required
  • Ability to obtain the appropriate pesticide license within the first 90 days of employment (company paid)
  • Ability to work in the field independently, manage route-based assignments and interact with our great customers inside their businessesand/or homes

What will my work environment be like?

Candidates must meet physical job requirements and safely perform the job duties with or without accommodations:

  • Safely use a ladder within the manufacturer's weight capacity
  • Occasionally lift and carry up to 50 lbs.
  • Safely access crawl spaces, attics, confined spaces, roof tops, etc. including the ability to climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.

At SAP, we enable you to bring out your best. Our company culture is focused on collaboration and a shared passion to help the world run better. How? We focus every day on building the foundation for tomorrow and creating a workplace that embraces differences, values flexibility, and is aligned to our purpose-driven and future-focused work. We offer a highly collaborative, caring team environment with a strong focus on learning and development, recognition for your individual contributions, and a variety of benefit options for you to choosefrom.

The Concur Deal Desk is part of the GCF Specialized Deal Support CoE which supports Concur, Callidus and OEM / MSP LoB’s. The Specialized Deal Support CoE is a critical pillar within the GCF Commercial CoE, which provides deal support for cloud deals. The team offers great learning and development opportunities and exposure to market leading cloud businesses.

The team provides direct or indirect support on topics such as pricing, revenue recognition, contracts, legal, DoA etc.

The Commercial Business Partner is responsible for evaluating fair value of Concur deals, revenue recognition and providing overall deal support to Concur deals in assigned regions. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and have experience with complex revenue recognition issues. This role will have a strong partnership with SAP Revenue Recognition, Concur Sales, Legal and Accounting.

Specific Responsibilities:

• Will act as the primary Deal Desk & Revenue Recognition contact for one of the identified regions, as well as provide back-up coverage to other regions, as required.

• Work with Sales, Legal and Contracts to ensure agreements are structured in accordance with SAP's Revenue Recognition policies

• Review and approve deals to safeguard financial results, and maintain compliance and consistencies with established policies

• Responsible for carrying out tasks and assisting the field sales team via the quote to order process in the Concur Systems.

• Review contracts and related documents to identify appropriate revenue recognition issues.

• Provide support for the Quarterly Business Reviews and quarterly / annual audits performed by internal and independent auditors.

• Keep current on the latest Revenue Recognition training content & programs.

• Drive automation of manual processes and identify/implement best practices.

• Independently leads tasks and projects such as interactions with Pricing, Legal, CFO’s office, CFR, DoA review, GRC / SOX Compliance etc.

• Provide sales enablement to regional sales team

Qualifications

Work Experience:

• BA/BS in Accounting or Business Administration with focus on accounting topics; financial designation preferred.

• Strong experience consisting of Revenue Recognition, Audit, Financial Controlling, Commercial Deal Support, etc.

• Expertise in IFRS 15 is a strong plus.

• Strong general business acumen and can contribute finance expertise to address a variety of business challenges within a complex and dynamic organization

• Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical skills. Able to discern alternatives and make objective recommendations, understand how to effectively work with other business groups to accomplish goals.

• Experience with major CRM systems (e.g., SAP, Salesforce, etc.) preferred, but not required.

• Natural curiosity regarding how to make process improvements.

• Ability to remain flexible in a fast paced and rapidly changing environment.

• Well-developed oral and written communication ability to interact with upper levels of management.

• Able to work within a team environment effectively, as well as function independently.

Critical Performance Competencies:

• Planning and Organizing – Establishes a systematic course of action for self and others to assure accomplishment of a specific objective, determining priorities and allocating time and resources effectively.

• Initiative – Prepares for problems or opportunities in advance.

• Interpersonal – Direct and diplomatic in dealing with others to achieve goals.

• Influence – Demonstrates different influence styles as appropriate to situation while maintaining positive relationships.

• Communication – Effectively transfers thoughts and expresses ideas using speech, listening skills and writing skills to influence others to gain their support.

• Adaptability/Flexibility – Quickly adjusts to new, different, or changing requirements.

• Accountability – Holds self and others accountable for results.

Value Competencies:

• Displays passion for & responsibility to the customer

• Displays leadership through innovation in everything you do

• Displays a passion for what you do and a drive to improve

• Displays a relentless commitment to win

• Displays personal & corporate integrit

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves.At SAP,you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better and more equitable world.

title: Senior Business Consultant
description:
ABOUT TEMENOS

Temenos powers a world of banking that creates opportunities for billions of people and businesses everywhere. We have been doing this for over 30 years through the pioneering spirit of our Temenosians who are passionate about making banking better, together.

We serve over 3000 clients from the largest to challengers and community banks in 150+ countries. We collaborate with clients to build new banking services and state-of-the-art customer experiences on our open banking platform, helping them operate more sustainably.

At Temenos, we have an open-minded and inclusive culture, where everyone has the power to create their own destiny and make a positive contribution to the world of banking and society.

THE ROLE

This role is open ONLY for Ciudad de Mexico.

The position of a Senior Business Consultant is responsible for providing functional support and expert advice to existing and future clients throughout all implementation stages of the Temenos T24 Core Banking Software and/or other TEMENOS software products. The Principal Business Consultant focuses especially on the most complex functional issues, ensures that all actions are taken to fully satisfy the client’s functional needs and provides coaching to less experienced Consultants.The Principal Business Consultant is client-facing and focuses on more complex business issues with little or no direct supervision, provides functional guidance to both the Project Manager and Client and mentors less experienced Consultants

OPPORTUNITIES
  • You will focus on more complex functional/business implementation problems.
  • You will provide training and knowledge transfer to less experienced consultants.
  • You will participate in the review of client organization, processes and workflows and contribute to the proposal of the target organization, processes and workflows to maximize the Client’s benefit from the Temenos products.
  • You will identify any gaps between the Client’s business / functional requirements and the Temenos product capabilities and generate proposals for their resolution (e.g. workarounds, changes in processes or application changes) and ensure any solutions proposed are realistic and within the agreed scope of the project.
  • You will run functional workshops to meet specific project needs.
  • You will validate all functional decisions for the projects to ensure optimum utilization of Temenos products.
  • You will define customization needs for Temenos products as per agreed business definitions.
  • You will write specifications, if and when needed, for local development and ensure that the relevant development team(s) have a clear understanding of these specifications.
  • You will supervise, if and when needed, over specific tasks of the implementation plan.
  • You will participate in functional testing to support Client testing.
  • You will provide clear and concise functional documentation for internal and external use.
  • You will conduct client functional training as necessary.
  • You will provide regular updates and feedback to the Project Manager in order to achieve project goals.
  • You will coordinate with the TEMENOS maintenance groups to ensure that the product problems encountered by the client are understood and resolved.
  • You will complete functional support hand-over details and obtain client readiness agreement before go live.
SKILLS
  • You should have minimum of five to eight years of experience in Finance or banking software consultancy or other equivalent industry knowledge. Deposit, Lending or Trust operations experience is a plus.
  • You should have i n depth understanding of financial and banking business processes.
  • You should have strong knowledge of a banking/financial software application with implementation experience.
  • You should have expert skill using PowerPoint, Excel and Word as well as other MS Office applications.
  • You should have excellent interpersonal skills and written communication a must.
  • You should have ability to facilitate and conduct presentations and workshops.
  • You should have strong analytical and organizational skills.
  • You should have ability to work with limited supervison, take ownership of assigned tasks and independently interface with clients.
  • Temenos competencies in one or more of the following a plus:
    a.Knowledge of the Temenos Implementation Methodology or other implementation methodology.
    b.Knowledge of T24 Core Banking System (Release 13 or higher)
    c.Process Workflows
    d.Knowledge of any T24 Modules (Core: Customer, Acconts, Payments, etc.)
    e.T24 General Ledger and Financial Accounting & Reporting
    f.T24 Parameter set-up
    g.Close of business (COB) support
    h.Knowledge of T24 Data migration
    i.T24 Architecture (TAFJ)
    j.Arrangement Architecture (AA Deposits and/or Loans)
    k.T24 testing.
    l.Channels
    m.Functional knowledge of Wealth Manager or Wealth Suite
VALUES
  • Care
  • Commit
  • Collaborate
  • Challenge
SOME OF OUR BENEFITS include:
  • Maternity leave: Transition back with 3 days per week in the first month and 4 days per week in the second month
  • Civil Partnership: 1 week of paid leave if you're getting married. This covers marriages and civil partnerships, including same sex/civil partnership
  • Family care: 4 weeks of paid family care leave
  • Recharge days: 4 days per year to use when you need to physically or mentally needed to recharge
  • Study leave: 2 weeks of paid leave each year for study or personal development

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

description:
Talking about Siemens in Brazil means talking about doing what matters to society.

Siemens Real Estate (SRE) is the real estate entrepreneur of Siemens AG and one of the leading CREM companies. We are responsible for a real estate portfolio of 8 million square meters of office and production space at around 1,600 locations worldwide and manage it from a cost, transparency, and efficiency perspective.

As a real estate expert, you lead the Regional Asset Management unit South America (approx. 75000m² of building space).

See our opportunity for Siemens Real Estate (SRE) Business Area Manager

What will your responsibilities be?

  1. You align the local strategy with the global asset and property strategy, including standards and guidelines, and ensure their implementation.
  2. You have an overview of the real estate market development, conduct market and location analyses, and ensure they are in line with the market.
  3. You develop real estate strategies to optimize space utilization according to customer needs and market development, and actively manage vacancies.
  4. You directly manage a total of 13 employees.
  5. You establish customer relationships in your RAM and support their goal achievement through appropriate real estate activities.
  6. You set and manage the goals for property management.
  7. You prepare investment applications and coordinate them internally within the Hub/SRE.
  8. You negotiate contracts including terms (e.g., price, termination conditions), prepare and conclude lease agreements (internal/external) on behalf of the owner.
  9. You evaluate and select external providers with the support of technical and operational property management.
  10. You identify and minimize operational risks and initiate corrective actions.
  11. You drive the continuous optimization of the real estate cost position in office and industrial buildings (IBIT optimization).
  12. You cooperate and support in the acquisition and disposal of real estate, especially in due diligence and contract negotiations for purchases and sales.

What requirements are we looking for?

  • You have a bachelor’s/master’s degree, a commercial education, or equivalent professional experience with a real estate background, such as engineering or finance.
  • You bring 10-15 years of experience in the operational real estate sector as well as advanced commercial knowledge, project management, real estate development, and opportunity/risk management.
  • You have extensive expert knowledge in corporate real estate management, real estate market, strategic portfolio development, asset, property, and facility management.
  • You have a strong customer orientation and excellent skills in stakeholder and especially service provider management.
  • In addition to negotiation experience/skills, you possess comprehensive management and leadership skills (especially strategic thinking, assertiveness, motivational and persuasive ability, flexibility, and adaptability).
  • You have basic experience in the digitization and decarbonization of real estate.
  • You have very good Portuguese, Spanish, and English skills, both written and spoken.
  • This position will be based in Sao Paulo, Brazil, with additional responsibilities for Argentina, Colombia, Chile, Peru, and Ecuador.

  • CLT, hybrid model (home office some days of the week!)
  • Anhanguera - São Paulo

Descrição da Empresa

Fundada em 1986 por Paulo Martins da Luz (in memoriam), após sua brilhante trajetória profissional de 36 anos na multinacional TEXACO BRASIL S/A, onde atuou como diretor de Recursos Humanos, com o intuito de trazer para o mercado uma referência de terceirização de serviços e de mão de obra temporária. A PMLUZ CONSULTORIA DE RECURSOS HUMANOS LTDA é especializada no fornecimento de mão de obra temporária e efetiva, fornecimento de treinamentos de equipes, administração de folhas de pagamento e gestão de pessoas.

O propósito de Paulo Martins estava em melhorar os processos de RH que eram bastante arcaicos e defasados na década de 80, com excelência nos processos de recrutamento e seleção, avaliações psicológicas para atividades de riscos, gestão administrativas e de pessoas, otimizando e diminuindo as burocracias e os riscos para seus clientes.

Em 2005, Alexandre Cerqueira Luz, formado em Administração com Pós-Graduação em Marketing e MBA em Recursos Humanos, assumiu a presidência da Pmluz Consultoria, trazendo uma visão moderna e bastante original, oferecendo um serviço mais personalizado para atender as particularidades de seus clientes.

Com grande experiência no mercado no segmento de Petróleo, Gás e Energia, foi fundada a PMLUZ ENERGY SERVIÇOS DE LOGISTICA LTDA, empresa especializada na prestação de serviços e cumprimento das normas criadas pela ANP 44/2013, elaborando uma metodologia atualizada, para flexibilizar e adaptar tais procedimentos, respeitando sempre a legislação, nossos valores e filosofia.

Hoje somos o GRUPO PMLUZ com prestação de serviços para contratos efetivos e temporários, gestão de pessoal, terceirização de folha de ponto e muitos outros serviços, atendendo nossos clientes mantidos por mais de três décadas, em suas sedes e filiais em todo o Brasil.

Aditivar manualmente caminhão tanque com movimentação de tambores e assegurar o controle e o monitoramento de todas as atividades (qualidade, segurança) envolvendo recebimento, armazenagem e entregas de produtos.

title: ESPECIALISTA EM PRODUTO DE DADOS (Inteligência de Negócio)
description:
ESPECIALISTA EM PRODUTO DE DADOS (Inteligência de Negócio)

Recrutadora | Headhunter | Marketing Digital | Edição de vídeos | Fotografia

Nosso cliente é uma empresa nacional de tecnologia, com forte atuação no segmento médico e hospitalar, situada na região da Vila Olímpia, São Paulo, capital.

Esta posição estará conectada na estrutura Comercial e terá como missão:

Atuar como ponto focal técnico e estratégico dos produtos de dados, garantindo sua implementação eficiente, qualidade contínua e valor percebido pelos clientes. Esta posição tem como missão traduzir a complexidade dos dados em soluções claras, escaláveis e de alto impacto, apoiando a indústria farmacêutica na tomada de decisões e na geração de valor para o ecossistema de saúde.

Além de liderar a gestão do ciclo de vida dos produtos existentes, o Especialista de Produto de Dados contribui com a evolução da proposta de valor, conectando dados a oportunidades de negócio, impulsionando relacionamento com clientes, e promovendo uma cultura de excelência técnica, melhoria contínua e visão consultiva.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  1. Gestão do Ciclo de Vida do Produto de Dados: Gerenciar os produtos de dados existentes (como MarketSync DB, Performance 360 e módulos complementares), garantindo sua relevância e valor para os clientes.
  2. Implementação e Suporte Técnico: Liderar a replicação e implementação dos produtos de dados em Power BI para novos clientes, incluindo configuração, gestão de acessos e garantia da qualidade dos dados entregues. Ser o ponto focal técnico para os clientes durante o onboarding e uso contínuo.
  3. Gestão de Relacionamento com Clientes (Pós-venda): Atuar como o principal ponto de contato para os clientes após a venda, acompanhando o uso dos produtos, garantindo a satisfação, coletando feedbacks e identificando oportunidades de upsell ou cross-sell.
  4. Treinamento e Capacitação: Desenvolver e ministrar treinamentos para equipes internas e clientes sobre a utilização eficaz das ferramentas e produtos de dados.
  5. Desenvolvimento de Negócios e Produto: Mapear stakeholders e identificar dores/necessidades na indústria farmacêutica que possam ser solucionadas com dados. Contribuir ativamente para a ideação e desenvolvimento de novos produtos de dados ou melhorias nos existentes.
  6. Melhoria Contínua: Colaborar com as equipes de Vendas e Produto para refinar o pitch de vendas e a proposta de valor dos produtos de dados. Coletar e estruturar feedbacks dos clientes para direcionar melhorias.
  7. Estratégia de Implementação: Ser o direcionador da estratégia e dos recursos envolvidos na implementação e fornecimento dos dados aos clientes.
  8. Qualidade de Dados: Monitorar e gerenciar a qualidade dos dados nos produtos entregues aos clientes.

Experiência: Mínimo de 4 a 6 anos de experiência com produtos de dados, BI ou engenharia de dados, preferencialmente em empresas de tecnologia, consultorias analíticas ou no setor da saúde/farmacêutico.

Experiência em ao menos duas das três frentes a seguir:

- Implementação técnica de soluções de dados e BI (ex: Power BI, SQL, Data Warehouse).

- Relacionamento com clientes e pós-venda técnico, com forte viés consultivo.

- Desenvolvimento ou gestão de produtos de dados (como dashboards, indicadores, soluções white label).

Desejável vivência em projetos com indústria farmacêutica, dados de mercado de saúde, inteligência de mercado ou efetividade de vendas.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação Acadêmica: Graduação completa em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Estatística, Matemática Aplicada, Economia, Administração com foco em dados, ou áreas correlatas.

Desejável Pós-graduação/MBA em áreas como Data Science, Análise de Negócios, Gestão de Produtos ou Saúde Digital será considerado diferencial.

  • Power BI: Domínio avançado (Modelagem de dados, DAX avançado, criação de relatórios e dashboards interativos, administração do serviço Power BI - workspaces, RLS, gestão de acesso). Experiência comprovada na implementação de soluções PBI para clientes.
  • Excel: Domínio avançado (Fórmulas complexas, tabelas dinâmicas, Power Query, análise de dados).
  • SQL: Conhecimento sólido/intermediário (Capacidade de escrever consultas complexas para extração, análise e validação de dados).
  • Python: Conhecimento básico/intermediário (Compreensão de scripts de manipulação de dados, familiaridade com bibliotecas como Pandas é um diferencial).
  • Databricks: Conhecimento básico/intermediário (Entendimento de como os dados são processados e armazenados na plataforma).
  • Conceitos de Data Warehouse e Modelagem de Dados: Sólida compreensão.
  • Gestão da Qualidade de Dados: Experiência ou forte conhecimento em processos e técnicas.
  • Comunicação Excepcional: Habilidade de comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara e concisa para públicos variados (técnicos e não técnicos, internos e clientes). Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Foco no Cliente e Gestão de Relacionamento: Paixão por entender e resolver os problemas dos clientes, construir relacionamentos de confiança e garantir o sucesso do cliente. Experiência prévia em Sucesso do Cliente (Customer Success), Consultoria ou Pós-venda técnico é altamente desejável.
  • Visão de Negócio: Capacidade de entender o mercado (indústria farmacêutica é um grande diferencial).
  • Pensamento Analítico e Resolução de Problemas: Forte capacidade de analisar dados, identificar tendências, diagnosticar problemas e propor soluções eficazes.
  • Organização e Gestão de Projetos (Leve): Habilidade para gerenciar múltiplas implementações de clientes simultaneamente, definir prioridades e cumprir prazos.
  • Proatividade e Autonomia: Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente, tomar iniciativa e buscar soluções.
  • Habilidade de Apresentação e Treinamento: Conforto e eficácia ao apresentar produtos, insights e ministrar treinamentos.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia na indústria farmacêutica ou com dados de saúde.
  • Experiência em funções de inteligência de mercado, marketing ou efetividade focadas em dados.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis.

Híbrido, sendo 2 (dois) dias presenciais e 3 (três) dias remoto.

  • Manter registros precisos das inspeções realizadas, dos serviços prestados e das peças substituídas.
  • Elaborar relatórios de diagnóstico e reparo para documentar o trabalho realizado e comunicar as necessidades de manutenção aos clientes.

title: Senior network analyst
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Network Analyst role at Netvagas .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

About Azion

We are the largest Edge Computing platform in Latin America and a global leader in the industry. Our platform allows companies to operate with agility, reducing latency and increasing the reliability of their applications. We are focused on simplifying application building and looking for passionate and innovative individuals to join our team!

At Azion, you will have the opportunity to develop and be connected to cutting-edge technology, immersed in a culture centered on innovation and a high-performance team, unlocking new possibilities and working with the future of technology.

About The Position

We are looking for a Senior Network Analyst to join our Engineering team at our São Paulo/SP office. As a Network Analyst, you are a highly technical and hands-on professional, focused on building 24x7 mission-critical environments and staying connected to the most efficient and innovative methodologies for managing mission-critical environments.

Main responsibilities include:

  1. Design, configure, and manage high-availability networks, ensuring performance and security.
  2. Administer advanced routing protocols (BGP, OSPF) and WAN network technologies (MPLS, VPN, SD-WAN).
  3. Implement and maintain network security policies, including firewalls, IDS/IPS, NAC, and network segmentation.
  4. Monitor network infrastructure, identifying and resolving performance and security issues.
  5. Integrate and support network solutions in hybrid environments (on-premises and cloud, such as AWS, Azure, GCP).
  6. Automate network tasks using tools like Ansible, Python, and Terraform.
  7. Document network configurations, procedures, and topologies.
  8. Collaborate with information security teams to ensure compliance with regulatory standards.
  9. Support network infrastructure expansion, migration, and modernization projects.

Requirements

  1. Strong experience in configuring routers with BGP/MBGP, OSPF/ISIS, and ASN deployment.
  2. Experience with Juniper and Arista/Cisco routers.
  3. Relevant professional experience, including working with UNIX/Linux environments.
  4. Solid knowledge of IPv4/IPv6, TCP/UDP, DNS, DHCP, etc.
  5. Knowledge of network automation (Python, Ansible, or Grafana).
  6. Experience with cloud networking (AWS or Google Cloud Networking).
  7. Experience with firewalls and VPNs.
  8. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  9. Advanced English proficiency.

Differentials

  • Experience in scripting (Shell, Python, Perl).
  • Experience with distributed systems, SDN, streaming, web servers, storage, and cloud servers.
  • Fluent English.

Benefits & Azion Way Of Life

  • CLT hiring model;
  • Health and dental plan;
  • Flexible VR and VA (Flash Card), including during vacation periods;
  • Transport voucher without payroll deduction;
  • Annual internal hackathons;
  • Mobility allowance (additional amount for travel);
  • Freestyle (incentive to customize the workstation);
  • Platform for language courses (English and Spanish);
  • Stock options (according to policy);
  • Birthday day off;
  • TotalPass;
  • Flexible working hours (really flexible);
  • Nomad program to work from anywhere for up to 3 months a year;
  • Annual international exchange program.

FlexWork Model

We offer a FlexWork model that prioritizes acculturation and collaboration. For the first three months, you will work on-site in the local office, an essential step in building solid relationships and a genuine connection with our values and culture. After this period, you will have the possibility to apply for the hybrid model, working on-site at least three times a week. This approach balances interaction in person and autonomy, creating a dynamic and productive working environment.

At Azion, all applications are welcome, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, pregnancy, disability, ethnicity, color, country of origin, or religion. We believe that an inclusive environment contributes to our success and that respect is present in all our relationships.

Come and join our team! We look forward to getting to know you and walking a path of success in technology together!

En Claro promovemos una cultura de respeto e igualdad de oportunidades. Seleccionamos a nuestros talentos basándonos en el valor que pueden agregar a nuestro negocio.
Buscamos profesionales con capacidad para desenvolverse en un contexto de evolución e innovación digital, que generen nuevos desafíos y desarrollen oportunidades de negocios.
Tu rol será:
Liderar como Product Manager la estrategia, desarrollo y comercialización de productos Cloud IaaS, PaaS y SaaS . Ser el responsable de gestionar el portafolio de soluciones en colaboración con proveedores tecnológicos, asegurando que se ajusten a las necesidades de los clientes finales y se mantengan competitivas en el mercado.
Tus principales desafíos serán:

  • Definir y gestionar el roadmap de productos Cloud (IaaS, PaaS y SaaS), alineando la estrategia con las necesidades del negocio y la evolución del mercado.
  • Evaluar nuevas oportunidades de productos y servicios, analizando tendencias, competencia, viabilidad técnica y demanda del cliente para expandir el portafolio de soluciones Cloud.
  • Liderar la implementación de nuevos servicios, coordinando con proveedores tecnológicos y equipos internos para garantizar una ejecución eficiente y alineada con los objetivos de calidad, costos y plazos.
  • Optimizar el ciclo de vida de los productos Cloud, asegurando su evolución continua, mejoras en usabilidad, rendimiento y adaptabilidad a las necesidades de los clientes.
  • Impulsar estrategias comerciales y de adopción, desarrollando campañas y acciones para potenciar la llegada de los productos Cloud a distintos segmentos a través de los canales adecuados.
Qué necesitamos de vos:
  • Formación universitaria o terciaria en carreras de Lic. o Ingeniería en Sistemas de Información, Informática, Ciencias de la Computación, Telecomunicaciones o Electrónica, Marketing y Comercialización, e idoneidad para desarrollarse en el cargo.
  • Contar con más 3 años de experiencia en gestión de productos (idealmente Cloud).
  • Conocimiento sólido en nubes públicas (Azure, AWS o GCP).
  • Experiencia trabajando con proveedores tecnológicos para el desarrollo y comercialización de productos.
  • Experiencia en la definición y ejecución de estrategias de go-to-market.
  • Inglés escrito y oral avanzado.
  • Capacidad analítica y orientación a métricas para la toma de decisiones.
  • Adaptabilidad en entornos dinámicos y de rápida evolución.
  • Simplicidad en tu forma de pensar y hacer.
  • Vocación de servicio.

description:
Join to apply for the Site ID and Feasibility role at IQVIA .

The Global Site Identification and Feasibility specialist supports the administration of the clinical systems and tools utilized by Development Operations. Works in close collaboration with Development Operations teams, study start-up and/or CROs to provide key inputs, metrics, and outputs to support the selection of the most suitable sites for our clinical studies.

Essential Functions:

  6. Track feasibility responses and report to internal stakeholders.
  7. Troubleshoot issues in the feasibility process.
  8. Stay updated on regulations and industry trends related to site feasibility.
  9. Support enrollment forecasting and discuss scenarios with stakeholders under supervision.

Minimum Requirements:

  1. B.S. in a scientific or allied health field (or equivalent).
  2. 2+ years of experience in site identification, especially with North America and LATAM.
  3. Experience with trial optimization tools and methods.
  4. Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  5. Knowledge of clinical research and drug development concepts.
  6. Experience collaborating with stakeholders.
  7. Ability to prioritize multiple projects within tight timelines.
  8. Excellent communication skills.
  9. Experience in project management in academic, CRO, or sponsor environments.
  10. Experience with data analysis and interpretation.
  11. Proficiency in Excel.

description:
Acolher a necessidade do associado e, com a ajuda da tecnologia, interpretar e gerar insights a partir de dados do associado, sugerindo as melhores soluções financeiras.

  1. Consultor financeiro: Com base nos dados da carteira, estimular os associados sobre soluções financeiras, verificando se fazem sentido para seu momento de vida.   • Experiência de 2 anos na gestão de carteira em instituições financeiras;

  • Certificação CPA 10 ou CPA 20 será um diferencial nos processos seletivos.

Sobre o Sicredi:

Somos a primeira Instituição Financeira Cooperativa do Brasil, há mais de 120 anos, sempre inovando e desafiando o que fazemos, impulsionados pelo trabalho de nossos colaboradores.

Nosso propósito é construir uma sociedade mais próspera ao lado de mais de 45 mil talentos que acreditam nessa transformação. Evoluímos constantemente, mantendo a essência do cooperativismo para superar barreiras, conquistar novos horizontes e promover maior inclusão, diversidade e equidade.

Por isso, somos reconhecidos como a Melhor Empresa para se Trabalhar no Brasil 2024 , segundo a GPTW!

Estamos em busca de talentos que queiram fazer parte da construção de um mundo melhor. Venha fazer parte dessa transformação conosco.

title: Manager Americas - Customer Success
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Manager Americas - Customer Success role at Canonical

4 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Manager Americas - Customer Success role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Customer Success Regional Team Manager.
To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to help our team of Customer Success Managers across regions. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success and an obvious passion for new technologies. Ideally, you have been a Customer Success Manager at one point in your career and naturally evolved to a leading position.
You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you are to provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. You are comfortable dealing with ambiguity and quickly adapt to changes. You seek collaboration with other teams to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility is to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work hand-in-hand with the Head of Customer Success.
CSMs engage a diverse customer base and follow diverse CSM motions to provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer. The right candidate would adapt to this diversity and bring broad experience to the team.
Location: This is a globally remote role
The role entails:

  • Strategic planning and analysis: preparing communication plans, Team Meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive upsells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.
  • Customer interactions and support to your team: you resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention. You work closely with your team members to ensure timely resolution.
  • Team management: you are passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. You are ready for regular performance reviews with team members. While your help in identifying areas for improvement is key, you are asked to celebrate excellence, recognise your team's achievements, and set goals for individual growth within the team.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.
  • Documentation and reporting: you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.
What we are looking for in you
  • Excellent academic results at school and university
  • Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM
  • Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries
  • Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results
  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
  • Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration
  • Experience growing and developing a CSM team
  • Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice-to-have skills
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:

  • Adoramos celebrar o sucesso, por isso contamos com programas de reconhecimento por tempo de trabalho, comportamentos, liderança, momentos de vida, entre outros.
  • E como sua família também é importante para nós, estendemos benefícios como nossa Linha de Bem-Estar, Convênios e Descontos, programas de Bolsas de Estudo para seus/suas filhos(as), Planos de Auxílios para diferentes momentos de vida, entre outros.

Na PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos em promover uma equipe de trabalho diversa, criando um espaço colaborativo, equitativo e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas - independentemente de como nos parecemos, de onde viemos ou a quem amamos - tenham suas vozes ouvidas. description:
Join to apply for the Senior Market Manager role at Airbnb .

Airbnb was founded in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home. Since then, it has grown to over 5 million hosts welcoming more than 2 billion guest arrivals worldwide. Hosts offer unique stays and experiences, enabling guests to connect authentically with communities.

  • Strong quantitative skills for data-driven decision-making.
  • Ability to work strategically and tactically in ambiguous environments.

Based in São Paulo, Brazil. No relocation support provided.

Want to help us, help others? We’re hiring!

GoFundMe is a global community of over 150 million people who come together every day with the common purpose of helping one another. Our mission is to help people help each other through our best in class technology. Preferred...

  • Experience with Spring Boot, Kotlin or Java, AWS, Kafka, Kubernetes.

Why you’ll love it here...

  • Make an Impact: Be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive difference in millions of lives every year.

  • Holistic Support: Enjoy financial assistance for things like hybrid work, family planning, and commuting, along with generous parental leave, flexible time-off policies, and mental health and wellness resources to support your overall well-being.
  • Growth Opportunities: Participate in learning, development, and recognition programs to help you thrive and grow.
  • Commitment to DEI: Contribute to diversity, equity, and inclusion through ongoing initiatives and employee resource groups.
  • Community Engagement: Make a difference through our volunteering and Gives Back programs.

description:
Job description

Somos o Grupo Energisa! Com mais de cem anos de história, a Energisa é o maior grupo privado com controle 100% nacional do setor elétrico brasileiro. Nosso portfólio diversificado abrange distribuidoras, concessões de transmissão, geração de grande porte renovável, uma marca inovadora de soluções energéticas – a (re)energisa –, com geração distribuída por fonte renovável, comercialização de energia no mercado livre e serviços de valor agregado, além de uma central de serviços compartilhados, uma empresa de contact center e a fintech Voltz, a primeira do nosso setor no mercado de contas digitais. Recentemente, diversificamos nosso portfólio com a inclusão da distribuição de gás natural, através da aquisição da ES Gás E Norgás!



Main responsibilities

Estruturar, coordenar e monitorar processos operacionais, com foco na eficiência, confiabilidade e sustentabilidade das atividades das distribuidoras de gás e energia. Influenciar, disseminar e garantir a continuidade do planejamento da expansão, operação e manutenção das redes de distribuição de gás e/ou energia. Maximizar a rentabilidade dos ativos, garantir a otimização da arquitetura e dimensionamento da rede, garantir a implementação e o cumprimento das políticas de qualidade e eficiência nas operações de construção e manutenção das redes, planos de melhoria contínua e indicadores de desempenho, assegurando o alinhamento entre as metas corporativas e as operações regionais, nos centros de atendimento e nas operações de emergência.

  1. Planejamento Estratégico: Desenvolver planos táticos e estratégicos para as operações das distribuidoras, garantindo eficiência no uso de recursos e alinhamento às metas da holding. Estruturar cenários operacionais e financeiros para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  2. Gestão de Operações: Acompanhar a execução das atividades operacionais, identificando oportunidades de otimização de processos.
  3. Propor soluções que promovam a melhoria contínua e a redução de custos operacionais, sem comprometer a qualidade ou segurança.
  4. Análise de Desempenho: Estabelecer e monitorar indicadores de desempenho operacional (KPIs) para as distribuidoras. Desenvolver relatórios e dashboards para acompanhamento pela alta gestão.
  5. Integração de Processos: Promover sinergias operacionais entre as distribuidoras de gás e energia. Implementar melhores práticas e garantir a padronização dos processos operacionais em toda a holding.
  6. Projetos Especiais: Participar da implementação de projetos estratégicos, como expansão de redes de gás e energia, digitalização de operações e iniciativas de eficiência energética. Coordenar iniciativas de sustentabilidade, priorizando práticas que reduzam impactos ambientais.
  7. Gestão de Riscos: Identificar, avaliar e mitigar riscos relacionados às operações das distribuidoras. Assegurar a conformidade com regulamentações aplicáveis ao setor de gás e energia.
  8. Relacionamento com Stakeholders: Colaborar com lideranças regionais e equipes operacionais para garantir a execução dos planos. Atuar como elo entre a holding e as distribuidoras, assegurando que as diretrizes corporativas sejam implementadas localmente.


Requirements and skills

  1. Planejamento Estratégico: Capacidade de desenvolver planos operacionais e estratégicos com base em análises de cenários, projeções de demanda e uso eficiente de recursos.
  2. Gestão de Projetos: Experiência em condução de projetos utilizando metodologias como PMI, Agile ou SCRUM.
  3. Gestão de Processos: Domínio de metodologias como Lean, Six Sigma e PDCA para otimização de processos. Experiência em padronização de operações e definição de fluxos de trabalho.
  4. Uso de ferramentas analíticas como Power BI, Excel avançado e sistemas de ERP.
  • Possuir curso superior concluído é obrigatório.
  • Ter contato com a indústria de gás e distribuição de gás também é essencial.
  • Disponibilidade de residir no Rio de Janeiro.


Additional information

As PESSOAS são nossa maior ENERGIA. Pensando em seu bem-estar, oferecemos um leque de benefícios. Da só uma conferida no que você terá: • Vale alimentação ou Refeição para fazer as compras para sua casa ou comer no seu restaurante preferido; • Plano de saúde e odontológico para você e sua família; • Previdência privada para sua reserva financeira e investimentos; • Auxílio Creche para te apoiar nos primeiros anos com seus filhos; • Seguro de Vida, para dar mais tranquilidade a você e a quem você ama; • Participação nos lucros, como incentivo pelo seu trabalho e resultados; • Programas de qualidade de vida que garantem o bem-estar e promovem a saúde dos nossos colaboradores; • Programas de Bolsa de Estudo para te apoiar em qualificação profissional; • Gympass que te dá acesso a mais de 18 mil academias no Brasil. Certifique que seus dados estão atualizados e fique de olho na sua caixa de e-mail, sem esquecer da caixa de spam. At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Software at TRACTIAN

The software department at TRACTIAN is at the forefront of innovation, crafting an integrated ecosystem that revolutionizes maintenance and process management. Comprising a dynamic team of experts, the department develops an all-in-one software solution that seamlessly combines predictive maintenance capabilities with a comprehensive Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS). In daily work, the software department drives the convergence of cutting-edge technology and maintenance excellence to propel businesses toward unparalleled success.

O consultor de vendas é responsável por realizar vendas, representar a empresa e seus produtos ou serviços. Ele trabalha na linha de frente, em contato direto com os clientes, atendendo às suas necessidades, tirando dúvidas e oferecendo soluções que possam ser vantajosas para ambos os lados.

Join to apply for the Ubuntu Core Software Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Ubuntu Core Software Engineer to redefine the Linux experience in the embedded environments with the smallest, most secure, and updatable operating system in the IoT market. This is an opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, security, and the developer experience. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill with low-level operating systems, kernel, and device firmware.
Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardise the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances.
As an Ubuntu Core team member, you'll be designing and implementing software that runs on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC-V, and X86. You will work on boot mechanisms, bootloaders, storage partition layout, device trees, kernel and services.
Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company.
Location : This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region
The role entails

  • Write high quality code with unit tests to create new features
  • Debug Linux system level issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Integrate diverse bootloaders and maintain gadget snaps
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 times a year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have experience with C or Golang, and Shell
  • You have a solid understanding of Linux and a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • You have personal or professional experience with Linux-capable devices such as Raspberry Pi
  • You have interest in learning or experience in one or more low-level systems and security facilities such as:
    • Bootloaders in ARM and X86, such as piboot, uboot, grub-uefi
    • Systemd and units, udev, initrd, graphics
    • OS level firmware daemons and CLI applications
    • Linux security implementations - TPM, FDE, LUKS, HSM, etc.
  • You may have experience or knowledge of Yocto
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

The Immigration team and our customers come from different cultural and nationality backgrounds and this adds to the variety and diversity of our work. Remaining updated on industry events/circumstances that may be relevant to the client.
  • Communicating regularly with clients to build a strong relationship while focusing on business needs and ensuring that client service review meetings are held regularly, with formal agendas and presentations
  • Attends client meetings, telephone & video conferences/ webinars as required.

Responding to email and telephone enquiries in a timely manner and ensuring that advice is comprehensive and accurate, managing expectations where needed and escalating issues promptly and appropriately.

Gestão dos componente phase in/phase out, itens correntes e novos projetos. Assegurar o correto processo de abastecimento da planta de itens vindo de diferntes regiões do mundo. Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Product Owner (PO) com espírito de dono, foco em resultados e paixão por criar soluções que gerem valor para o negócio e para o cliente.   1. Experiência comprovada como PO em projetos com metodologias ágeis ;

  4. Disponibilidade para atuar de forma híbrida em Porto Alegre – RS .

  1. Comunicação clara e assertiva;
  2. Capacidade de colaboração com diferentes áreas;
  3. Visão sistêmica e estratégica;
  4. Organização, planejamento e autonomia na execução.

  1. Ensino superior completo ou em andamento;

  1. Remuneração compatível com o mercado;

  • Investigar incidentes e acidentes a bordo, elaborando relatórios e planos de ação;
  • Promover treinamentos, DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança), simulados de emergência e campanhas educativas voltadas à segurança, saúde e meio ambiente;

  • Apoiar a gestão de resíduos e controle ambiental a bordo;

  • Experiência prévia em atividades de segurança do trabalho embarcado ou em operações fluviais/maritmas será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre normas regulamentadoras (NRs), especialmente aplicáveis ao ambiente embarcado (NR-30, NR-29, entre outras);
  • Habilidades em elaboração de relatórios, inspeções e treinamentos;
  • Boa comunicação, proatividade e capacidade de atuação preventiva;
  • Disponibilidade para regime de trabalho 22 dias embarcado por 10 dias de folga .

Informações adicionais:

  • Conhecimento em gestão ambiental;
  • Cursos voltados à segurança em ambientes embarcados (ex.: HUET, CBSP, etc.);
  • Carteira de Habilitação categoria B;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão SSMA (ex.: SSO, ISM Code, ISO 45001, ISO 14001).

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Essa oportunidade destina-se também às pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Sustentabilidade

O valor sustentável está no centro de nosso propósito como empresa. Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.
